question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which boy did you like best?
Do you kiss under the mistletoe?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow! These holiday cookies look absolutely delicious! They're sure to be a smash hit at Mallika's party.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hmm... Maybe I should stick around for a few minutes to make sure people enjoy them.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just a few minutes and then... Then I'll come right back to The Bakery and spend the rest of the night all by myself.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No... Mallika was right. Ms. Rose would want me to visit with my friends.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That settles it! I'm going to Mallika's party, and I'm going to have a great time!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh no! The holiday cookies are burnt! It'll be close, but if I work fast I might be able to whip up a new batch before the party starts.
Kim begins kneading dough for the new batch of cookies.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I've gotten so tired working these long hours that I'm starting to make dumb mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: A party could be exactly what I need to recharge my batteries.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ms. Rose would tell me life is too short to spend sulking.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Great. It's settled then...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Not exactly. I do have a lot of Holiday Cookies to bake, and...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's it! Kim, I'm not giving you a choice. You `will` come to my party!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! Kim, I'm not giving you a choice. You [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] come to my party!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Here. I'm placing an order for five dozen gingerbread men and I want them delivered to my house tonight at nine o' clock sharp.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: See you then! Let's go, Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: See you, Kim!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No! Wait, Mallika! Spike!
The bell over the door jangles as Mallika and Spike exit the Bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Five dozen Gingerbread Men... by tonight?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I better get to work!

rounds.subtitle: Bake cookies! Pick the right ingredients!
Bake cookies! Pick the right ingredients!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Is that how little our friendship means to you?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What? No... I...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What I'm trying to say is that ever since Ms. Rose passed away, I've been running this place all by myself and...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, we both know you were practically running this place before Ms. Rose passed on. It's `why` she left you the Bakery.
nodes.text_bbcode: Kim, we both know you were practically running this place before Ms. Rose passed on. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] she left you the Bakery.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's a ton of work, but it's nothing you can't handle.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're upset because when Ms. Rose passed on, you lost a close friend.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's normal to feel upset. But you have other friends, too, and they miss you.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now ask yourself, would Ms. Rose want you to lock yourself away like this, or would she want you to have fun?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I totally understand.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Of course, I do. Ms. Rose was a close friend. When she passed away, you must've felt like you lost a part of yourself.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And lately, you've been spending so much time in the Bakery because it reminds you of the good times you and Ms. Rose shared.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow. I guess you do understand what I've been going through.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now ask yourself this, Kim. Would Ms. Rose want you to lock yourself away like this, or would she want you to have fun?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, whatever happened between me and Phil is in the past. I'm dating Spike now, and I'm really happy.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And if there was even a chance that Phil could make you as happy as I am... I'd hate myself if I stood in the way of that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Especially since... You know... The way things turned out with Spike...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, stop right there, Mallika. You don't have to feel bad about what happened.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess my point is that I won't feel right about it if you're not just as happy as I am. And if that means dating Phil, well, I want you to do it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks for letting Phil stay at the party.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: The only thing I'm concerned about is Spike. I don't know how he's going to react when he finds out my ex is here.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika, Spike is really cool. I'm sure he'll be fine with it. Just tell him the truth.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're right...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm not being ridiculous. I saw the way you were looking at each other under the mistletoe.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe I do think he's attractive, but I only just met him. It's way too early to know if there's any spark.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, there were sparks. In fact, there were practically fireworks.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? Fireworks?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Totally. We're talking sparklers, bottle rockets, roman candles...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, maybe you're right. Maybe there was something there... but all this is beside the point...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm so busy with school and the Bakery that I barely had time to come to this party. How could I have a relationship?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And even if I did have the time, I would never do anything that would jeopardize our friendship.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, you're not going to jeopardize our friendship.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Thanks for being honest with me, Kim. I'll be honest with you, too.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: The truth is, when I saw you under the mistletoe with Phil, I was a little thrown.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So you are mad at me?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, of course not! In fact, it's the exact opposite! I'm happy for you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You are?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sure. I asked you to come to the party tonight because I wanted you to get out of the Bakery and have some fun.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And as far as I'm concerned, talking to cute boys qualifies as fun.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well okay, but I don't want things to be awkward.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: So wait, you're not going to kiss?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No. We're not going to make out just because a couple of kids are pressuring us to.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But kissing under the mistletoe is a Winter Holiday tradition!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You have to!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kay! Kel! What are you doing? You promised Howard you'd be on your best behavior.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: To be fair, that's not exactly saying much.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Find someone else to pester! Now!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We'll let you two off the hook...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: For now!
The Twins dash off.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, I'm so glad you came! You can put those cookies on the table right by the...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh! I see you didn't come alone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Phil helped me carry in the cookies.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I should probably get going. I was just walking by. Mallika, I really didn't mean to intrude on your party.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Intrude? You're kidding, right? The more the merrier!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I think that if Phil needs to get going...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Phil, do you?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No, not really, but...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Great! Come on, Phil. I'll show you around.
As Phil and Spike exit the Living Room, Mallika turns to Kim.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, can I speak with you for a second... In private?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Bringing the gingerbread cookies you ordered...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, not that! What are you doing with my ex-boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait, you mean... That was `your` Phil? The one who dumped you over the summer?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, you mean... That was [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] Phil? The one who dumped you over the summer?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, I'd heard stories, but I never knew he was so... Cute.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Cute?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, that's not what I meant to say. I meant to say he was... Snoot... Err, Snooty. That's it!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil is way too full of himself to be attractive.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, tell the truth. Do you like Phil?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why not? It's tradition, isn't it? Besides it's been a while since I kissed a boy and... You're pretty cute!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: `Pucker up!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Pucker up![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... Kim, I think you've gotten the wrong idea about me.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: The truth is you seem pretty cool, but we only just met.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Maybe later, after we get to know each other, I'll want to kiss you... But kissing you right now wouldn't mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The thing is... We only just met a few minutes ago.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But what if we totally hit it off tonight?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Okay. I think I get where you're headed...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: If we have a good time tonight, we can plan to meet back here.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly! That way, if we do end up kissing, it will mean something real.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know... I mean, I've seen you around school. You're good at pool, right?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That's me! So, Kim, what were you doing before disaster nearly struck?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was getting my cookies and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh no! My cookies!
Kim turns to the van. The Gingerbread Men are intact and still warm.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Relax, Kim! Your cookies are fine, but maybe I should help you carry them inside... Just to be safe.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. Better safe than sorry.
Kim and Phil carry trays of cookies into the Dining Room.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hey, you two! Start smooching!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You heard my sister. Time to lock lips. Time to suck face. Time to...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh oh... Look up!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why? What's up?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That would be the sprig of `mistletoe` we're standing beneath.
nodes.text_bbcode: That would be the sprig of [color=#e23b3b][i]mistletoe[/i][/color] we're standing beneath.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh... Mistletoe? But that means we're supposed to...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kiss!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kiss!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Kim, this is just a stupid tradition. We don't have to do this.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're right. We don't have to do this, but...

nodes.prompt: We don't have to do this, but...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: We don't have to do this, but...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I never said you couldn't. No need to get confrontational.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not being confrontational. I'm being... Um...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to snap at you like that. I really don't get out much these days and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Maybe I've forgotten how to interact with people.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That's a shame...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're Kim, right? I remember seeing you diss-battle one time. You really put yourself out there.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I did? I mean, you really think that?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Definitely. I'm Phil, by the way.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, you should tell your pride to watch its step. This curb is pretty icy.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll be sure to pass on the message.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, when you do, I bet you'll do it in style.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I will?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're Kim, right? I remember seeing your diss-battle. Your rhymes were epic.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I'm Phil, by the way.
Later that night, Kim parks the Bakery delivery van in front of Mallika's house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow! All this snow is making it really chilly! I'd better get these cookies inside before they cool down.
As Kim opens the trunk, her feet slip out from under her!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Eeek!
Before Kim can fall to the ground, Phil steps in and catches her!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, are you all right?

options.label: I can take care of myself!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoo! I made it!
Phil and Kim zip down the slope and glide to a gentle stop at the bottom of the hill.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wow! What a rush!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That was incredible!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Want to do it again?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Definitely!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, were you guys sledding down that hill? That is so killer!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know, right? We rule!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm glad I came... Even if you did have to twist my arm.
A few minutes later, Kim trudges down the hill. She is wet, miserable, and more than a little cranky.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Kim, are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm fine, but I'm not sure that sledding was the best idea.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are you kidding? That looked awesome!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... It did?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And the way you handled that wipeout. Classic!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It was?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Totally!
Phil and Kim zip down the slope...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Kim, you're slipping! Try to hang on!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I can't! I...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Noooooooooo!!!
Kim tumbles off the back of the makeshift sled and careens face first into a snowbank.
There is an awkward moment of silence...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You know what we need to do?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Eat ice cream straight from the container?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No, we need to do something crazy, something that will take our minds off of who's dating who or why...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay! Like what?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, it's snowing and Mallika lives next to a big park. We could go sledding!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh. That sounds good, but... Don't we need a sled for that?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're right. I guess it was a stupid idea.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Cookie trays!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Cookie trays?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: They're long and flat, and they're big enough to sit on. Do you think we might be able to use one instead of a sled?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I think it's definitely worth a try.
Meanwhile, inside the party...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay, Kel... what are you doing in there?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh... Nothing! And it definitely doesn't involve any amphibians.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We promise!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, that's... Weird.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Does this have to do with the mistletoe? Mallika said you were hassling people about 'not kissing' earlier.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kissing under the mistletoe is a Winter Holiday tradition!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Traditions are important!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! Like giving presents or singing carols or convincing boys to lick icy flagpoles.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really...? And when have you two ever given anybody a present?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We thought about it!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And it's the `thought` that counts!
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's the [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] that counts!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm not sure that's how it works.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Whatever... If people don't want to follow tradition...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're going to make them!
The door to the bathroom swings open! Kay and Kel scramble past Howard and Spike!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Huh... What do you think those two are up to?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm guessing we'll find out sooner or later.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sigh... At least people can use the bathroom again.
Meanwhile, outside...
Kim and Phil grab cookie trays from the Delivery Van and race to the top of the hill.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! This hill is steep! This is crazy!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Which is exactly why we have to do it! Now hang on tight and don't let go!

rounds.subtitle: Cross the dance floor skillfully! Don't trip!
Sled down the hill! Don't wipe out!
Cross the dance floor skillfully! Don't trip!
Sled down the hill! Don't wipe out!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Why would I lie about something like that?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean... It's just... Spike wanted to date Mallika. Why would you be any different?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Maybe because I was dating Mallika, and then I broke up with her. Obviously things weren't working out for us.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait a minute... Does this have something to do with Spike?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No... I mean, maybe... Yes...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's possible that I wanted to date Spike, but Spike ended up dating Mallika instead.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: And do you still like Spike?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No! Of course not! Spike and Mallika are great together. I just...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Just because you're happy for someone else doesn't mean you like being alone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. I guess I really do know how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This is kind of a secret, but I used to like Spike. As in `like` like.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is kind of a secret, but I used to like Spike. As in [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] like.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Really? But Spike is...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Dating Mallika, I know. I wanted to be with him, but now I see how happy he is with Mallika, and I just...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Just because you're happy for someone else doesn't mean you like being alone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I guess you really do know how I feel.
Kim slips out the back door and steps onto the porch.
Kim attempts to work her way through the kissing couples...
But she trips over a foot and... SPLOOOSHH!!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Aaahh! I spilled punch all over my dress!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: PARTY FOUL!
The music cuts out. The partygoers turn and stare.
Aghast, Kim races for the door.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, I want you to know you can talk to me about anything.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I do. And I will. I guess I'm just not ready right now.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Well, whenever you are...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Howard, what is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm really sorry.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry? About what?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I looked away for half a second, and Kay and Kel gave me the slip.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: By the time I found them, they'd already locked themselves in the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not sure, but they had an animal cage with them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I think they're planning something.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... Did you say an `'animal cage'?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... Did you say an [color=#3b78e2][i]'animal cage'?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't worry, Mallika. I'll help Howard handle it.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike... Just... We'll talk soon, okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Sure.
Spike and Howard exit toward the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know I should've talked to Spike about Phil, but I totally just chickened out.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I hope Kim is having better luck than I am.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just my luck, when I finally meet a guy I like, it turns out he used to date my friend.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know Mallika said it would be okay, but I really don't want to strain our friendship.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I should just forget about dating altogether...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Maybe dancing will take my mind off thoughts of romance.
Just then, the fast dance music abruptly stops.
Hector leans in to the microphone.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The weather outside may be frightful, but this is your chance to cozy up to someone delightful.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And have a romantic night full of... Err... Romance?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, guys, grab a girl and slooooooooowww dance!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: A slow dance? Just what I needed.
Couples congregate onto the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uck... Major P.D.A. I'm going to go outside and get some air!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Only... The dance floor is pretty packed... It's going to be tough to work my way out!

rounds.subtitle: Cross the dance floor skillfully! Don't trip!
Sled down the hill! Don't wipe out!
Cross the dance floor skillfully! Don't trip!
Sled down the hill! Don't wipe out!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Math partners?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes. Which is how I know him. From before... When we were math partners.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And that's it?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Of course! What else would there be? Just a boy and a girl doing math.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know, one plus one equals two.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uhh...?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Not that we were like that. Phil and I were more like one plus one is still one and then also another one.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But that second one definitely never dated the first one.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Are we still talking about math?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yes...?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Be close? As in date?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No! Of course not! That would mean my ex-boyfriend would be at the same party as you, my current boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, Phil and I used to be close... At school... And then sometimes after school... Or at the movies...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You mean you used to go on dates?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa, calm down. I get that you're really not comfortable talking about it. I won't push you, but...
Later that night...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Three years ago, my parents finally gave me the `Green Glyder` BB Gun I'd always wanted.
nodes.text_bbcode: Three years ago, my parents finally gave me the [color=#e23b3b][i]Green Glyder[/i][/color] BB Gun I'd always wanted.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You have a Green Glyder? Those things are seriously dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I know... How do you think I lost my eye?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait a second... Earlier you said you lost your eye fighting rogue department store Santas.

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Like you guys know anything!

nodes.speaker: Spike

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Oh, that's a relief.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Why? Did you think something was going to go wrong?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, of course not! I just...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh. One other thing, we were getting a little low on beverages, so I filled the punch.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You punched Phil?!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What?! No!!!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But you just said...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, is something wrong?

nodes.text: Spike, you're sweet. And you know I would never do anything to hurt you, right?

nodes.text: Spike, Phil and I... We used to...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: About that... We have bad news and worse news. Which do you want first?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The bad, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Well, the bad news is that Phil already left the party.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Great... So what's the worse news?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: The worse news is you're standing beneath the Missile Toad.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait a second... Did you say 'Missile Toad'?

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ack!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: That'll teach you to break with super-important Holiday traditions!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Eww! Eww! I can taste frog in my mouth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Howard, did you see what your sisters just did?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: 'Missile Toad'? They truly are... Evil.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww... Either Kim isn't a princess or that frog isn't really a prince!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, do you hear a high-pitched screaming?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, what is that?
Kay and Kel streak past at top speed!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Great party, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Thanks for having us over!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Those... Those.... Little demons!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim, are you okay? What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't ask... And as for you, Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait! What did I do?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're the one who dragged me to this terrible party. As far as I'm concerned...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This is all your fault!
Kim crosses to her Delivery Van.
A few moments later, the engine revs and Kim peels away.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! Kim was really upset.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No kidding! Next time I throw a party, that girl is definitely `not` getting an invite.
nodes.text_bbcode: No kidding! Next time I throw a party, that girl is definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] getting an invite.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: You know... As long as you're busy losing invitations, why not shred mine, too?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Phil told me you and he used to date!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I think you only started dating me to make him jealous!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What...? No! It isn't like that!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh yeah... Then why didn't you tell me Phil was your ex-boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Because I didn't know how you'd react if I told you, and...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whatever. If you want Phil so bad... I won't stand in the way!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait, Spike! No!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike?!
The next day at The Bakery...
A 'Closed' sign hangs in the window, but if you put your ear right up to the door...
You can hear someone softly sobbing.

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Phil? You mean 'Just Dissed By Kim' Phil?

nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Come here, you!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh... Okay. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Just because we had a good time and connected on a deep emotional level... That doesn't mean we should kiss.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Great. I knew you would understand. I'm just... You know, really busy with work right now.

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Phil

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Bye.

nodes.text: Yeah. Me, too.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think we should...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Coupley in there?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Single?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah... The truth is I didn't really just happen to walk by the party.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Ever since Mallika and I broke up, I've felt kind of lonely and...

nodes.speaker: Phil

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: But that isn't the same as wishing we were still going out.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: She's with Spike now, and he makes her happy. And more than that, I'm happy for her.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, I think...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, you'll have to ask Kim. The cookie trays were her idea.

nodes.text: Mallika...

nodes.text: I know.

nodes.speaker: Mallika

nodes.speaker: Spike

nodes.text: As you well know, the Winter Holidays are a time to spend with friends and family...
But this year, one student is toiling all by herself.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: ...Cold front moving in that has delivered the first `snow` Centerscore has seen in fifteen years...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The television keeps things from getting too quiet, but I really miss the conversations I used to have with Ms. Rose.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika. Spike. Hi. Can I get you something?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Actually, Kim, we need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Kim

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: About you! We've barely seen you for weeks.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You show up to school late, skip out early, drive off campus at lunch... Not to mention the parties.

nodes.text: And some of them were pretty killer! Hector threw this one party where you were supposed to dress up like you were from the eighties.

nodes.text: As you well know, the Winter Holidays are a time to spend with friends and family...
But this year, one student is toiling all by herself.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: ...Cold front moving in that has delivered the first `snow` Centerscore has seen in fifteen years...
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Cold front moving in that has delivered the first [i]snow[/i] Centerscore has seen in fifteen years...

nodes.text: Kim sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The television keeps things from getting too quiet, but I really miss the conversations I used to have with Ms. Rose.
The bell over the door jangles, signaling a customer entering the Bakery.
Make that two customers!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika. Spike. Hi. Can I get you something?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Actually, Kim, we need to talk.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Talk? About what?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: About you! We've barely seen you for weeks.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You show up to school late, skip out early, drive off campus at lunch... Not to mention the parties.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait. What parties?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Exactly my point. You don't know because you weren't at them.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And some of them were pretty killer! Hector threw this one party where you were supposed to dress up like you were from the eighties.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Only Brendan misread the invite and thought he was supposed to `bring` someone in their eighties.
nodes.text_bbcode: Only Brendan misread the invite and thought he was supposed to [color=#e23b3b][i]bring[/i][/color] someone in their eighties.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Everybody thought it was really funny until Brendan's Grandma won the mega Diss-Battle. That old lady's got a mouth like a trucker.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow... A Diss-Battle? That sounds... Really fun.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika and Spike seem pretty happy... But I'm not sure Phil is having the best time.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: That's too bad. It looks like Kim and Phil didn't end up working out.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Phil? You mean 'Playing Tonsil Hockey with Kim' Phil?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean Kim and Phil?
Giggling fiercely, Kay and Kel attempt to catapult a toad toward Spike and Mallika...

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: The bell over the door jangles, signaling a customer entering the Bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil, hi! What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: I was just in the neighborhood...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? Doing what?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Trying to come up with a good excuse to come see you, actually. Do you mind?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I `do` enjoy watching infomercials and reruns of reality TV, but... I guess you can stay.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] enjoy watching infomercials and reruns of reality TV, but... I guess you can stay.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Great!
For the first time in many months, the Bakery is filled with the sounds of playful laughter.
Well now! It looks like there really might be sparks between Kim and Phil.
But will they be able to turn one kiss into something more?
Come back and find out!
In the meantime, comfort yourself with the knowledge that you played an excellent game.
